name: Aphelion Halo Rim
core_rationale: Outermost high-altitude comet-drift ring of Continent 03 where Vesper's farthest gravity-anchors capture frost-coated star-shards at the edge of the twilight sky.
local_conflict: Rime-winged comet-drakes and astral-echoes circle the outer tether-buoys beyond the reach of standard sky-skiffs.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Sub-zero comet-tail shear sweeps the northern Outer Orbit Drift; Buoy-Keeper Astraea requires the Geode Resonance Prism before unlocking the outer mooring.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators say the buoys along the Aphelion Halo Rim chime whenever a shooting star passes beneath the archipelago.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A distant outer ring of frost-silver basalt islets tethered by hair-thin threads of violet starlight.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient celestial astrolabe is moored beyond the Outer Orbit Drift?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the outermost orbital ring of Continent 03 and connects West to Perigee Diving-Station.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Frost-silver basalt islets moored to captured comet-shards by threads of violet starlight.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m frost-basalt tether-bridges, 0.60m astrolabe sighting-desks, and 0.14m risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 grid connects Comet-Tether Span, Aphelion Buoy Haven, and Comet-Core Geode B1 across [49, 50] with sky_kin and spirit families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-outer-orbit-drift at [1, 0] as a Mystery frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal on Aphelion Buoy Haven.
